dimensions.assessment: Affects community banks with assets under $15 billion and federal banking regulatory agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Community banks qualify by having less than $10 billion in assets, along with meeting other criteria.Specifically, the bill increases this asset limit to $15 billion.

dimensions.assessment: Changes capital requirements and regulatory burdens for eligible community banks.
dimensions.evidence: A reduction in the leverage ratio eases capital requirements.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not mention direct federal spending or revenue changes.
Amends the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act and mandates agency reviews and new rules.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Economic Growth, Regulatory Relief, and Consumer Protection Act to adjust the Community Bank Leverage Ratio

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory changes to the leverage ratio threshold and ongoing regulatory frameworks.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than the end of the 180-day period beginning on the date of enactment of this Act... such agencies shall finalize rules

missing_information: Exact fiscal cost of the studies and agency rulemakings.
Specific number of community banks that will opt-in.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill adjusts the community bank leverage ratio framework and increases the qualifying asset limit from $10 billion to $15 billion, affecting participating community banks and federal regulatory agencies through reviews and rulemaking.
